mapper.sql: id, org_id, activity_id, account_id, display_name, note, status, decided_by, decided_at, cancel_reason, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registration (org_id, activity_id, account_id, display_name, note, status) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{accountId}, #{displayName}, #{note}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM registration WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE registration SET status = #{toStatus}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), cancel_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')

SELECT r.id, r.org_id, r.activity_id, r.account_id, r.display_name, r.note, r.status, r.decided_by, r.decided_at, r.cancel_reason, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM registration r JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE r.org_id = #{orgId} AND r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') AND a.registration_scope = 'INTERNAL' AND a.status = 'APPROVED' AND (a.start_time IS NULL OR a.start_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY r.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE registration SET display_name = #{displayName}, note = #{note}, status = 'PENDING', decided_by = NULL, decided_at = NULL, cancel_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE registration SET status = #{toStatus}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), cancel_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
